* Lantiq DUSLIC XS driver

Modified in 2026 to document standard reset properties and MaxLinear PEF
compatible strings while retaining the legacy binding.

Node describing DUSLIC XS platform SPI device

Required properties:
- compatible: one of "maxlinear,pef32001", "maxlinear,pef32002" or the
              legacy "lantiq,duslicxs"
- reg: SPI chip select line number the DUSLIC XS is attached to
- spi-max-frequency: the maximum SPI frequency used by the master, limit to 8MHz
- spi-cpha: required to set SPI mode 3
- spi-cpol: required to set SPI mode 3
- pinctrl-names: must be equal to "default"
- pinctrl-0: reference to pincontrol defining how and which
             pins to use for the SPI CS (chip select)

Optional properties:
- interrupts: interrupt number the DUSLIC XS is attached to.
- interrupt-parent: reference to the parent interrupt controller
- reset-gpios: reference to GPIO used for DUSLIC XS reset
- reset-interval-ms: interval of reset in milliseconds, must be set
                        when "reset-gpios" is defined.
                        Valid range: 5-500ms.

The legacy properties "intel,reset-gpios" and "intel,reset-interval" remain
accepted for compatibility with existing device trees.

Note:
- if "interrupts" and "interrupt-parent" properties are not defined,
  DUSLIC XS can still be run in polling mode

Example:
	dxs0: dxs@0 {
		status = "okay";
		compatible = "maxlinear,pef32001";
		reg = <0>;
		spi-max-frequency = <8000000>;
		spi-cpha;
		spi-cpol;
		interrupt-parent = <&gpio1>;
		interrupts = <8 8>;
		pinctrl-names = "default";
		pinctrl-0 = <&pinctrl_spi1_cs0>;
		reset-gpios = <&gpio0 18 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
		reset-interval-ms = <10>;
	};

	dxs1: dxs@2 {
		status = "okay";
		compatible = "lantiq,duslicxs";
		reg = <2>;
		spi-max-frequency = <8000000>;
		spi-cpha;
		spi-cpol;
		interrupt-parent = <&gpio1>;
		interrupts = <8 8>;
		pinctrl-names = "default";
		pinctrl-0 = <&pinctrl_spi1_cs2>;
		intel,reset-gpios = <&gpio0 15 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
		intel,reset-interval = <10>;
	};

	dxs2: dxs@1 {
		status = "okay";
		compatible = "lantiq,duslicxs";
		reg = <1>;
		spi-max-frequency = <8000000>;
		spi-cpha;
		spi-cpol;
		interrupt-parent = <&gpio1>;
		interrupts = <8 8>;
		pinctrl-names = "default";
		pinctrl-0 = <&pinctrl_spi1_cs1>;
		intel,reset-gpios = <&gpio_rst 14 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
		intel,reset-interval = <10>;
	};

	dxs3: dxs@4 {
		status = "okay";
		compatible = "lantiq,duslicxs";
		reg = <4>;
		spi-max-frequency = <8000000>;
		spi-cpha;
		spi-cpol;
		interrupt-parent = <&gpio1>;
		interrupts = <8 8>;
		pinctrl-names = "default";
		pinctrl-0 = <&pinctrl_spi1_cs4>;
		intel,reset-gpios = <&gpio_rst 15 GPIO_ACTIVE_HIGH>;
		intel,reset-interval = <10>;
	};
